text: {"lessons":["Even without trading, my account value moved with the market, so I need to manage the risk of what I hold rather than assume doing nothing keeps my savings safe.","Selling portions of all five stocks gave me more cash and reduced exposure, but I should decide how much to sell according to a steady plan, not just recent gains or losses.","My account’s overall changes were modest in these periods, but that does not guarantee future stability; I should keep my living needs and preference for avoiding large swings in mind."]}
